exposure: Availability of emergency obstetric care (EmOC) services
outcome: Number of facilities meeting EmOC requirements
Proportion of births occurring in EmOC facilities
cohort: Pregnant women in Bauchi State, Nigeria
finding: The availability, utilization, and quality of EmOC services in Bauchi State, Nigeria, were suboptimal, with a low proportion of births occurring in EmOC facilities and a high maternal mortality ratio.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery accounted for 3.6% of births in EmOC facilities and 0.2% of expected live births overall.
